title: Fix Vethea Crypts
description: This Datapack backports the new fixed DivineRPG Vethea Crypt structures from 1.21.1+ to older versions.
body:
This simple Datapack backports the new fixed DivineRPG Vethea Crypt structures from 1.21.1+ to older versions.

Sruggling with heavy air and dissipators is now only an optional thing.

Recommended DivineRPG version to go with this Datapack: 1.10.7.6
